# dsh-memory-markdown

Read-only enhancer for a **file-based long-term memory library** (markdown cards kept in git) in
Dee
pSeek Harness (DSH).
> MIT · zero runtime dependencies · host + settings page · 中文说明见文末
## Governance panels (0.6.x)
The settings panel now mirrors what the library scripts can do, and **hides any block whose script i
s missing** (it never assumes your library ships these tools):
| Panel | Needs | What it shows |

| Vector fallback | `memory.toml [vector]` | fallback switch, vector DB / local model readiness |
|
Search log | `tools/search-log.mjs` | query count, zero-hit rate, channel mix, **top zero-hit phrasi

ngs** (click to copy) |
| Regression gate | `tools/memory-preflight.py` | one button → rebuild index

, run golden set, compare against baseline, per-row PASS/FAIL |
| Persona drift | `tools/persona-dri
ft.py` | samples the replies it actually wrote in past sessions and scores caricature — **it does no
t know it is being measured**, so it cannot game the test |
Card-size thresholds are read from `memory.toml [card]` (`max_lines` / `max_bytes` / `soft_lines`),
so the panel always agrees with the library's own rules instead of a number baked into the plugin.
## What it does
| Feature | Detail |
| `memory_find` tool | Searches the library's cards: CJK by adjacent bigrams, Latin by whole words,
weighted title ×6 / keywords ×4 / body ×1. Returns card paths + matched terms + a snippet, then the

agent opens the card with `read`. |
| Memory digest injection | Appends one small `systemPrompt` sec
tion (default ≤900 chars, configurable): where the library is, which topics exist, and "search it be

fore guessing". |
| Settings page | A "Memory library" section under DSH Settings: a **governance da
shboard** (opening tax, scale & trend, layer health, consolidation, guard & backup, search tools), s
lider+number thresholds, seven one-click actions (checkup / backup / governance scan / new chat + pr
ompt / prompt templates / in-panel search / open the memory site), and toggles (digest on-off, tool
on-off, digest budget, search limit). |
| Built-in search engine | The reference ranking (CJK bigrams, title ×6 / keywords ×4 / body ×1, syn
onym groups, idf weighting) is compiled into the plugin, so search works with **zero setup**; `searc

hMode: 'script'` still honours an external search script. |
| One-click library | Pick a folder with
the host's native directory picker, or create a library in one click: scaffolded `INDEX.md`, a samp
le topic folder, a sample card and a usage note. The chosen path lives in this machine's runtime con

fig, so Windows and Linux each keep their own and nothing is typed by hand. |
| `/memory` command +
bundled skill | A slash command (`status` / `search` / `init` / `root`) plus a `memory-library` skil
l that teaches any agent the workflow — search first, write cards on real progress, keep the library
small — so no preset is required. |
## What it deliberately does NOT do

- **Never writes** to the library: no card edits, no commits, no pushes. For automation
(auto-commit

, periodic health checks) pair it with your own scheduled script.
- **Never rewrites conversation hi

story** — it only appends one prompt section.
- **No database and no cache**; the only state is one
small JSON config file.
## Requirements

- A memory library directory with an index file (default `INDEX.md`) and a search script
(default `t

ools/memory-find.mjs`). Any script speaking this contract works:
`node <script> --stdin --top <n>` (

query arrives on stdin) or `--stats` (library overview).
- DSH with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` resolvable
in the profile (a normal DSH install).
## Install

Then restart that profile.
## 60-second start (even if you have no memory library yet)

1. Install the plugin, then open **Settings → Memory library**.
2. Click **Create a new library** —

or **Choose an existing folder…** if you already keep markdown
notes somewhere. The path is written

to this machine's own runtime config (`<DSH_HOME>/memory-lite/config.json`),
so two operating system

s never fight over one value, and the picker always yields a native absolute path.
3. That's it: the

scaffold (`INDEX.md`, a sample topic, a sample card, a short usage note) is created
and the built-i
n search engine is ready — **no external script needed**.
Prefer to let an agent do the shaping? **Let an agent initialise it** copies an initialisation promp

t
and opens a new chat, so the agent can ask what you want to remember and build the topic folders.
### Where you will meet it
| Where | What you get |
| Settings → Memory library | the dashboard: opening tax, scale & trend, layer health, consolidation

, guard/backup, tools |
| Composer: `/memory` | `status` · `search <words>` · `init [folder]` · `roo

t <folder>` |
| `memory_find` tool | the agent searches the library before guessing |
| Plugins page

| a card for this bundle showing whether a library is configured |
| Below the composer | a one-lin
e notice while no library is configured yet (dismissible) |

lts instead of silently wiping values.

six data blocks (opening tax of the always-read files vs a configurable budget, library scale and a

7-day trend snapshot, layer health with oversized-card and duplicate-title lists, consolidation
